# Alpine Engineering

> We help software company owners get found by new clients who need exactly what they build.

Alpine Engineering (Alpine LTD) was founded in 2024 by Stanislav Petrov, who has built software since 2015. What a software company's owner already says about their work becomes their presence on every platform their prospects use, in their own words and under their own name. The site is one page in English.

## The page

- [How it works](https://alpine-engineering.eu/#how): One 40-minute call where we ask and you tell. A yes on the ideas, and a stop on any post. A full week of posts on every platform. Each one made from your words, in your voice.
- [Our record](https://alpine-engineering.eu/#who): We come from the same work you do. For a Big Four company, an AI agent that builds other agents, with a human in the loop between steps (Google Vertex AI, Python). For one of Europe's biggest retailers, we were part of the team building their cloud infrastructure and platform (FastAPI, Go, Kubernetes). We were part of the team that rebuilt a vibe-coded AI platform for teachers (Django, AWS).
- [Questions](https://alpine-engineering.eu/#faq): Will the posts sound like me? How much of my time does it take? Whose accounts are they? What if it doesn't work for me? Will a quiet month still come?
- [Free roadmap](https://alpine-engineering.eu/#gift): Answer eight quick questions, and you'll see which of the five stages you're at and the exact steps that move you to the next one. The roadmap itself: https://alpine-engineering.eu/roadmap.html
- [Join the list](https://alpine-engineering.eu/#ask): Join the list, and you get in before the launch, so you try it while we're still building it and what you tell us ends up in what everyone else gets.
